rules.title: Source-of-income discrimination prohibited in housing
rules.quote: It shall be unlawful: (a) For the owner of any housing accommodation to discriminate against or harass any person because of the race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, ancestry, familial status, source of income, disability, veteran or military status, or genetic information of that person.
rules.summary: Housing providers cannot discriminate against or harass any person because of their source of income.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1.   (SB 267)   Effective January 1, 2024.

rules.title: Financial standards must be based on tenant-paid rent portion for subsidized tenants
rules.quote: In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy, to do either of the following: (A) Use a financial or income standard in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing that is not based on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant.
rules.summary: For applicants with government rent subsidies, landlords cannot use financial or income standards that are not based on the portion of rent the tenant will actually pay.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1.   (SB 267)   Effective January 1, 2024.
rules.coverage_text: In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy

rules.title: Alternative evidence required for credit history screening with government rent subsidies
rules.quote: Use a person's credit history as part of the application process for a rental accommodation without offering the applicant the option, at the applicant's discretion, of providing lawful, verifiable alternative evidence of the applicant's reasonable ability to pay the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant, including, but not limited to, government benefit payments, pay records, and bank statements.
rules.summary: When screening applicants with government rent subsidies, landlords who use credit history must offer the applicant the option to provide alternative evidence of their ability to pay their rent portion instead, such as government benefit payments, pay records, or bank statements.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1.   (SB 267)   Effective January 1, 2024.
rules.coverage_text: In instances in which there is a government rent subsidy

rules.title: Aggregate income standards for unmarried cohabitants
rules.quote: To use a financial or income standard in the rental of housing that fails to account for the aggregate income of persons residing together or proposing to reside together on the same basis as the aggregate income of married persons residing together or proposing to reside together.
rules.summary: Housing providers must consider the combined income of unmarried people living together on the same basis as they consider the combined income of married couples.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1.   (SB 267)   Effective January 1, 2024.
